sentences.en: Psychologists are improving more than people's mental health.
sentences.zh: 心理学家们改善的不仅仅是人们的心理健康。

sentences.en: Obesity, smoking, heart disease, all of these physical health problems often involve behavior.
sentences.zh: 肥胖、吸烟、心脏病，所有这些身体健康问题往往都与行为有关。

sentences.en: In this episode, Dr. Norman Anderson, CEO of the American Psychological Association,
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，美国心理学会首席执行官诺曼·安德森博士，

sentences.en: explains how psychologists play an essential role on health care teams alongside physicians and other medical professionals.
sentences.zh: 解释了心理学家如何在医疗团队中与医生及其他医疗专业人员并肩工作，发挥至关重要的作用。

sentences.en: I'm Audrey Hamilton and this is Speaking of Psychology.
sentences.zh: 我是奥黛丽·汉密尔顿，这里是《心理学谈话》。

sentences.en: Today we are talking to Dr. Norman Anderson.
sentences.zh: 今天我们采访的对象是诺曼·安德森博士。

sentences.en: Dr. Anderson is the CEO of the American Psychological Association and the Director of the Association's Center for Psychology and Health.
sentences.zh: 安德森博士是美国心理学会的首席执行官，也是该协会心理学与健康中心的主任。

sentences.en: As our nation strives to improve health outcomes for all Americans, the APA and its Center for Psychology and Health are working to expand psychology's role in health
sentences.zh: 随着我国努力改善全体美国人的健康状况，美国心理学会及其心理学与健康中心正致力于扩大心理学在医疗领域的作用。

sentences.en: by improving access to psychological and behavioral health services, particularly in primary care settings.
sentences.zh: 通过改善心理和行为健康服务的获取途径，特别是在初级保健环境中。

sentences.en: Welcome, Dr. Anderson.
sentences.zh: 欢迎您，安德森博士。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Good to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: Dr. Anderson, could you explain in more detail the reasons for creating the APA Center for Psychology and Health?
sentences.zh: 安德森博士，您能更详细地解释一下创建美国心理学会（APA）心理与健康中心的初衷吗？

sentences.en: Well, we have a strategic plan in APA and one of the goals in the strategic plan is to advance psychology's role in improving the nation's health.
sentences.zh: 好的，美国心理学会制定了一项战略计划，其中一个目标就是提升心理学在改善国民健康方面的作用。

sentences.en: Most people understand that psychology and psychologists have a role in improving mental health,
sentences.zh: 大多数人都明白心理学和心理学家在改善心理健康方面发挥着作用，

sentences.en: things like depression and anxiety, but they don't really understand that we have a very important contribution to make in improving overall health, even physical health.
sentences.zh: 比如应对抑郁和焦虑，但他们并不真正了解我们在改善整体健康，甚至是身体健康方面，也能做出非常重要的贡献。

sentences.en: Our research has shown very clearly that behavioral and psychological factors contribute greatly to things like heart disease,
sentences.zh: 我们的研究非常清楚地表明，行为和心理因素对心脏病等疾病有很大影响，

sentences.en: the course of cancer, HIV-AIDS, diabetes.
sentences.zh: 癌症、艾滋病、糖尿病的病程。

sentences.en: So we have a very important role to play in overall health, not just mental health.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们在整体健康，而不仅仅是心理健康方面，发挥着非常重要的作用。

sentences.en: So the Center for Psychology and Health was created to really galvanize the resources we have within the central office to advance this overall goal in health.
sentences.zh: 所以，心理与健康中心应运而生，旨在真正整合我们中心办公室现有的资源，以推进这一整体健康目标。

sentences.en: One of the goals of the Affordable Health Care Act is to have integrated health care teaMs.
sentences.zh: 《平价医疗法案》的目标之一是建立综合医疗团队。

sentences.en: Can you tell us what those are and why they're important?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们那是什么，以及为什么它们很重要吗？

sentences.en: Integrated health care teams are very important in improving the overall health of patients.
sentences.zh: 综合医疗团队对于改善患者的整体健康状况非常重要。

sentences.en: Because we know that all health problems are multifaceted, they involve biological factors, psychosocial factors, behavioral factors,
sentences.zh: 因为我们知道所有的健康问题都是多方面的，它们涉及生物因素、社会心理因素、行为因素，

sentences.en: it's really important that you have the right mix of professionals working with patients on their health probleMs.
sentences.zh: 因此，让合适的专业人员组合与患者共同解决他们的健康问题至关重要。

sentences.en: For example, it's important that physicians work hand-in-hand with psychologists or other mental health professionals,
sentences.zh: 例如，医生与心理学家或其他心理健康专业人员携手合作非常重要，

sentences.en: with nurses, with people from physical therapy, from a whole host of disciplines to really serve the whole patient, to meet the whole patient's health care needs.
sentences.zh: 还要与护士、物理治疗师以及来自众多学科的人员合作，真正服务于患者整体，满足患者的全面医疗需求。

sentences.en: And research is beginning to show that when you do take this whole person approach to health, patient outcomes actually improve, and there can be some cost savings.
sentences.zh: 研究开始表明，当你采取这种全人健康方法时，患者的预后确实会改善，而且还能节省一些成本。

sentences.en: What kinds of behaviors are associated with disease?
sentences.zh: 哪些行为与疾病有关？

sentences.en: I mean, how exactly can a psychologist help treat disease?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，心理学家究竟如何帮助治疗疾病？

sentences.en: Well, in multiple ways.
sentences.zh: 嗯，方式有很多种。

sentences.en: You know, for example, at the most basic level, physicians are not really trained, unless they're trained in psychiatry,
sentences.zh: 你知道，举个最基本的例子，医生并没有受过相关培训，除非他们接受过精神病学培训，

sentences.en: to address mental health problems or to treat mental health probleMs.
sentences.zh: 否则他们无法处理心理健康问题或治疗心理健康问题。

sentences.en: So it's very important that those mental health problems get addressed in primary care.
sentences.zh: 因此，在初级保健中解决这些心理健康问题非常重要。

sentences.en: You know, primary care is really on the front lines of health care.
sentences.zh: 要知道，初级保健确实处于医疗保健的最前线。

sentences.en: So it's really important to have that mental health component available for patients right there within primary care.
sentences.zh: 因此，在初级保健中为患者提供心理健康服务至关重要。

sentences.en: But beyond mental health care, it's very important that you have professionals like psychologists available to address health behaviors more generally.
sentences.zh: 但除了心理健康护理外，拥有心理学家等专业人员来解决更广泛的健康行为问题也非常重要。

sentences.en: Things like diet, smoking, exercise, but also things like psychological stress, which is a major contributor to the course of illness.
sentences.zh: 比如饮食、吸烟、锻炼等问题，还有心理压力，它是导致疾病进程的主要因素。

sentences.en: Essentially, behavioral and social factors contribute to health and illness across the whole continuum, from the initiation of diseases.
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，行为和社会因素贯穿于健康和疾病的整个过程，从疾病的起始阶段就开始发挥作用。

sentences.en: For example, stress can actually change biology in ways to lead to a greater propensity to develop certain health probleMs.
sentences.zh: 例如，压力实际上可以改变生理机能，从而导致更容易出现某些健康问题。

sentences.en: These same factors can be used to prevent health problems, such as helping a person develop more healthy lifestyle habits,
sentences.zh: 同样这些因素也可以用来预防健康问题，比如帮助一个人养成更健康的生活习惯，

sentences.en: such as quitting smoking, losing weight, can actually help prevent illnesses.
sentences.zh: 像戒烟、减肥，实际上都有助于预防疾病。

sentences.en: But also, if a person has an illness like heart disease, certain factors like depression and stress can actually accelerate the course of their arteries occluding,
sentences.zh: 此外，如果一个人患有心脏病等疾病，抑郁和压力等因素实际上会加速其动脉阻塞的过程，

sentences.en: that is getting clogged, and lead to a heart attack.
sentences.zh: 也就是血管堵塞，并导致心脏病发作。

sentences.en: So throughout the whole continuum of illness, behavioral and social factors are important, and they have to be addressed.
sentences.zh: 因此，在整个疾病过程中，行为和社会因素都很重要，必须加以解决。

sentences.en: What is on the 2014 agenda for the Center for Psychology and Health?
sentences.zh: 心理与健康中心2014年的议程是什么？

sentences.en: Well, the Center works in four primary areas.
sentences.zh: 嗯，该中心主要在四个领域开展工作。

sentences.en: We work on advocacy, education and training of psychologists, communicating with our members and the public, and outreach to other organizations.
sentences.zh: 我们致力于倡导工作、心理学家的教育与培训、与会员及公众的沟通，以及与其他组织的联络。

sentences.en: And so we've got things planned in each of those areas.
sentences.zh: 我们在这些领域都有相应的计划。

sentences.en: For example, with advocacy, we're working to ensure that financing is available to help foster some of these integrated care teams that I spoke about earlier.
sentences.zh: 例如，在倡导方面，我们正努力确保有资金支持，以帮助培养我之前提到的那些综合护理团队。

sentences.en: Right now, we really don't have good models to give the public access to these teaMs.
sentences.zh: 目前，我们确实还没有好的模式让公众能够接触到这些团队。

sentences.en: So we're working with various organizations to help create those models.
sentences.zh: 所以我们正在与各方组织合作，帮助创建这些模式。

sentences.en: It's also very important that we communicate with psychologists about the importance of learning about participating in integrated care teams and in primary care.
sentences.zh: 同样重要的是，我们要与心理学家沟通，让他们了解参与综合护理团队和初级保健的重要性。

sentences.en: Most psychologists, frankly, weren't trained in this field.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，大多数心理学家并没有接受过这方面的培训。

sentences.en: So we have to educate our own profession about the importance of this and provide training tools to help them get up to speed so they can participate as professionals.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们必须让本行业的人员认识到这一点的重要性，并提供培训工具帮助他们跟上进度，以便他们能以专业人员的身份参与其中。

sentences.en: You know, one example of this is we have something called a briefing sheet series, which we are doing in collaboration with our interdivisional health care coalition.
sentences.zh: 你知道，其中一个例子就是我们有一个所谓的简报系列，这是我们与跨部门医疗保健联盟合作开展的。

sentences.en: These are divisions of APA who are interested in health, who have been really helpful to us in putting together fact sheets,
sentences.zh: 这些是美国心理学会（APA）中关注健康的部门，他们在编制事实清单方面对我们非常有帮助，

sentences.en: briefing sheets that we call them, on various aspects of health, such as psychologists working in primary care, psychologists working on the problem of chronic pain and obesity.
sentences.zh: 也就是我们所说的简报，内容涵盖健康的各个方面，例如心理学家在初级保健中的工作，以及心理学家在解决慢性疼痛和肥胖问题上的工作。

sentences.en: So this is sort of a first level of education for psychologists to get a brief one-page overview
sentences.zh: 所以，这算是心理学家接受教育的第一阶段，让他们通过一份简短的单页概述，

sentences.en: of how psychologists contribute to preventing or treating some of these so-called physical health probleMs.
sentences.zh: 了解心理学家如何为预防或治疗这些所谓的身体健康问题做出贡献。

sentences.en: We also use those briefing sheets to help create content for our website, so they can be found there.
sentences.zh: 我们还利用这些简报来帮助创建网站内容，以便大家能在网上找到这些信息。

sentences.en: And, frankly, this type of podcast series, we will use those briefing sheets as a context to bring in psychologists who are experts in things like chronic pain
sentences.zh: 而且，坦率地说，对于这类播客系列，我们将以这些简报为背景，邀请慢性疼痛等领域的心理学专家，

sentences.en: to share that information with our members and the public as well.
sentences.zh: 与我们的会员和公众分享这些信息。

sentences.en: Well, thank you, Dr. Anderson, for joining us.
sentences.zh: 好的，感谢安德森博士加入我们的节目。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: My pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: For more information about the Center for Psychology and Health, visit our website at speakingofpsychology.org.
sentences.zh: 欲了解更多关于心理与健康中心的信息，请访问我们的网站 speakingofpsychology.org。

sentences.en: With the American Psychological Association's Speaking of Psychology, I'm Audrey Hamilton.
sentences.zh: 这里是美国心理学会的《心理学谈话》，我是奥黛丽·汉密尔顿。
